note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: 1:1 centre crop is soft and cloudy with little crisp detail; the stretched surface reads as smeared rather than textured.
flags.fix: Add a fine high-frequency grain layer (as zepint_06 has) at low amplitude so the 1:1 crop shows real surface detail.

flags.problem: Glass at 1:1 shows regular small dash-like speckles that read as scanline or stamped noise rather than glass texture.
flags.fix: Remove or greatly reduce the injected high-frequency pattern over the glass pane; keep the blue tone and diagonal reflections.

flags.problem: The '0' digit edges are blurred with a soft grey halo at 8x, losing the crisp pixel-font silhouette of a flat graphic.
flags.fix: Upscale this flat-graphic glyph with nearest-neighbour or an edge-preserving pixel-art scaler so the outline stays hard-edged.
